provenance.note: The 5SYF Taxol-stabilized microtubule was reconstructed at 3.50 Angstrom and is matched to EMD-8322. This source is biological assembly 1 restricted to deposited operators 2 through 7: three neighboring protofilaments, each two dimers deep. All 40,908 atom sites are loaded once. Cumulative label-chain masks reveal the twelve polymer chains in their unchanged deposited coordinates; ligands and ions remain hidden. Author-chain emphasis gives every alpha chain blue and every beta chain amber. This is a staged structural illustration, not an assembly trajectory or kinetic simulation. Desktop timeline holds carry captions; the cumulative reveal is explicitly authored for the immersive player. The opening chapter applies only an oblique rotation; later chapters leave placement unchanged. A wearer placement hold overrides this opening angle.

chapters.title: Alpha arrives
chapters.caption: Blue: one alpha tubulin from 5SYF. Cells add whole alpha-beta pairs; this reveal shows one half first.

immersive.narration: Blue alpha tubulin. Real growth adds whole alpha-beta pairs.

chapters.title: Its partner arrives
chapters.caption: Amber beta completes the dimer. Paths and order are illustrative; every end position is measured.

chapters.title: Extend the strand
chapters.caption: Another alpha-beta pair adds at the beta end, the plus end, where microtubules grow fastest.
